svg.title: Sweet Home
svg.desc: An original illustrated cottage with sunlit oak floorboards, a woven rug, a cushioned sage sofa, a vintage television, a glowing stone fireplace, a shingled pet house, ceramic feeding bowls, a clawfoot bath, leafy plants, a storage chest and a front door into town.

g.aria-label: Sage sofa with soft cushions and a folded blanket
Your pet’s cedar house and soft bed
Wooden storage chest for your backpack
Bath cabinet and neatly folded towels
Enamel pet bath with brass taps, clear water and bubbles
